theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P), MeasurableSet M → Measurable f → Measurable G → (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * g x ∂μHE[n + 1]) → (∀ p : Euclid P → Prop, (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n + 1].restrict M), p x) → ∀ᵐ t, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t})), p x) ∧ (∀ c : ℝ, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n + 1].restrict M), f x = c → G x = 0) ∧ ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ∫⁻ x in M ∩ K, ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * g x ∂μHE[n + 1] ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ t, ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t} ∩ K, g x ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞
